11044|386a9ec7.name: Doctor Martin Felben
11044|386a9ec7.text: Once, it is true, I was human. What might otherwise be a shortcoming works to our advantage, $N, for I know human weaknesses intimately.

11046|6253ba70.name: Whuut
11046|6253ba70.text: All the bottles on this table are potions I brewed today. And they say a watched pot never boils. Ha!

11798|a2b097f2.name: Bunthen Plainswind
11798|a2b097f2.text: Would you like a flight to Thunder Bluff, courtesy of the Cenarion Circle?

11867|3f5ede7c.name: Woo Ping
11867|3f5ede7c.text: Have you come seeking training in the ways of armed combat?

12042|cf843c85.name: Loganaar
12042|cf843c85.text: Even within cold, stone walls such as the ones that shelter this town, one may find tranquility and peace.  In fact, you may find them everywhere you are... simply look inside yourself for such balance.

1289|fe52f4ea.name: Gunther Weller
1289|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

12997|6ce695f2.name: Monty
12997|6ce695f2.text: Monty be me name an' rats be me game.

1323|877c4b1d.name: Osric Strang
1323|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

1340|76d04af9.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
1340|76d04af9.text:
Welcome to Thelsamar, your home away from home in Loch Modan!

Thelsamar is a nice place, but it's not all beer and salted meat for those who answer the call to duty!  If you're willing to face danger in the name of the Alliance, then read the poster outside the Thelsamar branch of the Explorers' League.

1416|c14f3f06.name: Grimand Elmore
1416|c14f3f06.text:
If you've come looking for the finest craftsmanship on this or any other continent in the world, then you've come to the right place!

Grimand Elmore, at your service!

1430|0c543544.name: Tomas
1430|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

1430|b48f927f.name: Tomas
1430|b48f927f.text: I can teach you how to cook!

14727|5457bc8c.name: Vehena
14727|5457bc8c.text:
Aye, you there!  If you want to earn the respect of the Darkspear, then you can start by donating valuable resources for those in need!  Textiles and bandages don't grow on trees, ya know.

Rather than cash in various cloth pieces you find adventuring, donate them!  Doing so will earn you the recognition of the Darkspear!

15350|44b49612.name: Horde Warbringer
15350|44b49612.text: War is upon us, $N.  It's time for every member of the Horde to answer the call and join the fight against the cowardly Alliance.

1572|04178a2e.name: Thorgrum Borrelson
1572|04178a2e.text: Mark my words!  You won't find faster gryphons anywhere in the Eastern Kingdoms than the ones right here in Thelsamar!

1573|10cfc531.name: Gryth Thurden
1573|10cfc531.text: The Wildhammer dwarves might have fast steeds, but can those Aerie Peak gryphons stand the heat of The Great Forge?  I think not!

1651|c2467ddc.name: Lee Brown
1651|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

197|877c25a9.name: Marshal McBride
197|877c25a9.text: Hey, citizen!  You look like a stout one.  We guards are spread a little thin out here, and I could use your help...

2226|dd7de3ae.name: Karos Razok
2226|dd7de3ae.text: Greetings.  Our bats are well trained and fed.  You'll not find faster.

233|f729d74e.name: Farmer Saldean
233|f729d74e.text: Rough times, huh, $N? No matter where you turn someone needs help, and my wife and I are no exception.

2388|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Shay
2388|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

2393|e26243eb.name: Christoph Jeffcoat
2393|e26243eb.text: Can I show you what I have for sale?

295|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Farley
295|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

3216|13f1d3f9.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|13f1d3f9.text:
Listen closely to what you are told and do not quickly trust, or distrust.  For even friends serve their own ends, $c.

Our great Warchief knows this, and to prove that there are warlocks within the Horde who do not wish to destroy it from within or gain control over it, I have volunteered to aid our young leader in anyway I can.

3296|c407ea01.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|c407ea01.text: Speak to Pephredo at the Darkbriar Lodge in the Valley of Spirits, up above and to the west of the Valley of Strength.

3347|9cc6e14a.name: Yelmak
3347|9cc6e14a.text: I'm busy, $N. Tell Whuut to handle whatever it is. That young pup has been stewing all day long. He spends much more time like that, and he's going to hurt something.

352|c23f1156.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|c23f1156.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

4551|d37b59d0.name: Michael Garrett
4551|d37b59d0.text: How may I be of service?

460|86b6c1ef.name: Alamar Grimm
460|86b6c1ef.text: The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Keep up on your training, or you may find a similar fate.

461|86b6c1ef.name: Demisette Cloyce
461|86b6c1ef.text: The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Keep up on your training, or you may find a similar fate.

491|02f3f1d4.name: Quartermaster Lewis
491|02f3f1d4.text: I try to keep Sentinel Hill stocked, and that's not easy with all the action we see.

4949|9a2b62b8.name: Thrall
4949|9a2b62b8.text:
All members of the Horde are equal in my eyes, $N. We have all suffered many burdens, and if it were not for wisdom and honor, then we would be no better than the Scourge or my people while our blood was tainted by the demon Mannoroth.

It is your duty to aid the Horde and to defend our way of life. But it is also your duty to know when quarter and compassion should be given to friend and foe alike.

Understand this well. This is the new Horde, not some demon-spawned army who lack freewill.

523|d6469a91.name: Thor
523|d6469a91.text: Where are you going?  Well if you're looking to get there quickly, then look no further!

5495|86b6c1ef.name: Ursula Deline
5495|86b6c1ef.text: The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Keep up on your training, or you may find a similar fate.

5520|721fd095.name: Spackle Thornberry
5520|721fd095.text: Want to make your demons more powerful?  It'll cost you, but you've come to the right place.

5880|f341dff7.name: Un'Thuwa
5880|f341dff7.text: Greetings, $c.  Are you here to learn of the hidden arts?

5884|f341dff7.name: Mai'ah
5884|f341dff7.text: Greetings, $c.  Are you here to learn of the hidden arts?

5943|a28d29e1.name: Rawrk
5943|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

6373|721fd095.name: Dane Winslow
6373|721fd095.text: Want to make your demons more powerful?  It'll cost you, but you've come to the right place.

6374|721fd095.name: Cylina Darkheart
6374|721fd095.text: Want to make your demons more powerful?  It'll cost you, but you've come to the right place.

658|003beda2.name: Sten Stoutarm
658|003beda2.text: Ah, well aren't you a sturdy-looking one? Perhaps you can assist me with a thing or two. Not much help around here except for green apprentices, and they've other things to worry about.

6740|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Allison
6740|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

6741|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Norman
6741|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

6928|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Grosk
6928|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

7311|f341dff7.name: Uthel'nay
7311|f341dff7.text: Greetings, $c.  Are you here to learn of the hidden arts?

7953|de02093f.name: Xar'Ti
7953|de02093f.text: I can teach you the finer points of Raptor Riding, provided you have enough gold to cover the lesson!

8931|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Heather
8931|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

906|86b6c1ef.name: Maximillian Crowe
906|86b6c1ef.text: The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Keep up on your training, or you may find a similar fate.

931|c5ceacbe.name: Ariena Stormfeather
931|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

102-accept.name: Captain Danuvin
102-accept.text:
Stormwind has abandoned us.  A foul wind of depravity rustles through the plains of Westfall.  This was my homeland and I will not turn my back on the citizens who choose to remain here.  We, the former farmers, shall make our stand.

Your task, should you choose to accept, is to patrol the grasslands of Westfall.  Track down and slay the vile Gnolls that seem to be working in conjunction with the Deadmines thieves. Bring me eight Gnoll Paws and I will reward your bravery.
102-accept.title: Patrolling Westfall

106-accept.name: Maybell Maclure
106-accept.text:
Oh, I'm cursed!  My heart belongs to Tommy Joe Stonefield, but our families are bitter enemies.  So I can't see him, even though my eyes ache to gaze upon that handsome face!

Please, take this letter and give it to Tommy Joe.  He's usually at the river to the west of the Stonefield Farm, which is due west of here.
106-accept.title: Young Lovers

106-complete.name: Tommy Joe Stonefield
106-complete.text: Ah!  I can't stand us being apart.  I have to see her!!
106-complete.title: Young Lovers

106-progress.name: Tommy Joe Stonefield
106-progress.text: You have what??  Maybell is the light of my dull life.  Hurry, let me see her letter!
106-progress.title: Young Lovers

107-accept.name: Gramma Stonefield
107-accept.text:
I bet William Pestle has a potion to unite our two young lovers!

Here, take this note to William.  He's staying at the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire.
107-accept.title: Note to William

107-complete.name: William Pestle
107-complete.text:
My heart goes out to those two poor souls, Maybell and Tommy Joe.  I remember being young and in love, once.

There must be something I can do to help them!  Let me think...
107-complete.title: Note to William

107-progress.name: William Pestle
107-progress.text: You have a note from "Gramma" Stonefield, eh?  I haven't seen Mildred in years!  I wonder what she has to say...
107-progress.title: Note to William

109-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
109-complete.text:
Ah, so my friend sent you here?  How kind.  

Well the Stormwind Monarchy has abandoned our cause.  Now it is up to the People's Militia to keep the land free from corruption.  If our cause interests you, I can put your combat skills to use in the name of freedom.
109-complete.title: Report to Gryan Stoutmantle

1097-complete.name: Grimand Elmore
1097-complete.text: You're here to help with my delivery?  Very good!
1097-complete.title: Elmore's Task

111-accept.name: Tommy Joe Stonefield
111-accept.text:
Please, $N, talk with my Gramma.  If anyone can find a way to bring me together with Maybell, she can.

She's inside our house east of here.
111-accept.title: Speak with Gramma

111-complete.name: Gramma Stonefield
111-complete.text:
While our families are feuding, Tommy Joe and Maybell don't have much of a future, but... maybe we can get them together for just a little while.

Hm, what can we do...
111-complete.title: Speak with Gramma

112-accept.name: William Pestle
112-accept.text:
I can make an invisibility liquor for Maybell, so she can slip away from the Maclure Vineyards and go to Tommy Joe.  But to make the Liquor, I need some crystal kelp.

Although the kelp usually grows in the ocean... sometimes murlocs collect it.  See if the murlocs near Crystal Lake have any.  Crystal Lake is just east of Goldshire.
112-accept.title: Collecting Kelp

1164-accept.name: Genavie Callow
1164-accept.text:
The harlot! The swine! Kenata still lives; her family healthy and prospering while I suffer. Forsaken indeed!

My family is gone, taken by the plague. Our estate also forfeit; looted and burned during the war. And after all that, her and her lousy children had the audacity to steal the only precious belongings I had left.

I don't care about the things they stole any more. What I want now are their heads!

Kill them for me! Go to the Dabyrie Farmstead in Arathi, northeast of Refuge Point.
1164-accept.title: To Steal From Thieves

12-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
12-accept.text:
The People's Militia has but one goal:  To defend the lands of Westfall and return peace to our surroundings.  Unfortunately, the price of peace is often blood. 

One of my scouts has brought word of a band of Defias Trappers wreaking havoc nearby.  I have reports of Defias Trapper sightings near the Jangolode Mine to the Northwest as well as at the Molsen Farm and Furlbrow's Pumpkin Farm. If you seek to join our ranks, slay 15 Defias Trappers and 15 Defias Smugglers then return to me.
12-accept.title: The People's Militia

123-complete.name: Marshal Dughan
123-complete.text: Hm... I have heard of this "Collector" but I don't know whom he's working for.  Thank you for the schedule.  It will help us solve this mystery.
123-complete.title: The Collector

123-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
123-progress.text:
What?!?  We haven't had our people working the Elwynn mines for months!

Let me see that note you have...
123-progress.title: The Collector

1338-accept.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
1338-accept.text:
There is a dwarven armorsmith whose work I admire greatly.  His name is Furen Longbeard, and his skill is unmatched.  I need a new shield, and I must have one of his!

The problem is... Furen is far to the south, in the dwarven district within Stormwind.  In $r lands!  I can't imagine why he would live there, so far from Ironforge.  The humans must pay him a king's ransom to keep him there!

So, if you want to travel and don't mind making some money, then will you send Furen my request for a shield?
1338-accept.title: Stormpike's Order

1338-complete.name: Furen Longbeard
1338-complete.text:
Ah, a request from one of the Stormpikes.  That's a proud clan, full of quality dwarves.  Rich ones, too.

Thank you, $N.  I'll get to work on Mountaineer Stormpike's shield by the end of the day.
1338-complete.title: Stormpike's Order

1338-progress.name: Furen Longbeard
1338-progress.text:
A letter from the dwarven lands?  I wonder who would call from so far to the north...

Please, let me see the order.
1338-progress.title: Stormpike's Order

1339-accept.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
1339-accept.text:
I hear Mountaineer Stormpike is looking for a runner.  Someone to do a little traveling for him.  How about it?  Are you the $r for the job?

If so, then you'll find Stormpike at the top of the northern guard tower.
1339-accept.title: Mountaineer Stormpike's Task

1339-complete.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
1339-complete.text:
That's right.  I have a task that I can't do while I'm guarding.  In fact, it'll take you far from Loch Modan.

Your perfect chance for adventure!
1339-complete.title: Mountaineer Stormpike's Task

1359-accept.name: Apothecary Renferrel
1359-accept.text:
The wolf hearts you acquired possess a quality unseen in similar specimens.  There is a toxicity to them that should be deadly to the very wolves in which the hearts beat!

It's quite incredible, and we must study it further.  I kept a few samples of the hearts acquired.  Take them to my colleague, Apothecary Zinge.  You will find her in our headquarters in the Undercity.
1359-accept.title: Zinge's Delivery

147-accept.name: Marshal Dughan
147-accept.text:
If the "Collector" is taking gold from our mines then he's stealing from the kingdom!  Bring the Collector to justice, and bring me the ring mentioned in the pickup schedule you gave me.  It may tell us whom the Collector is working for...

That Pickup Schedule says the Collector is hiding out at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch.  You should search for him there.
147-accept.title: Manhunt

15-accept.name: Marshal McBride
15-accept.text:
$N, my scouts tell me that the kobold infestation is larger than we had thought.  A group of kobold workers has camped near the Echo Ridge Mine to the north.

Go to the mine and remove them.  We know there are at least 10.  Kill them, see if there are more, then report back to me.
15-accept.title: Investigate Echo Ridge

15-complete.name: Marshal McBride
15-complete.text: I don't like hearing of all these kobolds in our mine.  No good can come of this.  Here, take this as payment, and when you're ready, speak to me again.  I would like you to go back to the mines one more time...
15-complete.title: Investigate Echo Ridge

151-accept.name: Verna Furlbrow
151-accept.text:
Poor Old Blanchy!  Such a tired beast after all the work we put her through. I fed her before we left the farm, but we weren't expecting the wagon to break on us. If you could bring her a few handfuls of oats from the fields, I'd be grateful.

I bet you could find some around all of the farms in Westfall, if you can steer clear of those horrific machines that have taken over. There are several farms southwest of here.
151-accept.title: Poor Old Blanchy

151-complete.name: Verna Furlbrow
151-complete.text: Thank you so much, $N!  Poor Old Blanchy will be so happy!
151-complete.title: Poor Old Blanchy

151-progress.name: Verna Furlbrow
151-progress.text: Old Blanchy is on her last leg.  Did you happen to find any oats for her?
151-progress.title: Poor Old Blanchy

153-accept.name: Scout Galiaan
153-accept.text:
The Defias Front is constantly shifting.  I've been following their movements for quite some time now.  On a side note, I've ascertained that many members of the gang can be tracked by the Red Leather Bandanas they wear.

Bring me 15 of these Bandanas and I'll see to it you are rewarded.
153-accept.title: Red Leather Bandanas

1598-accept.name: Drusilla La Salle
1598-accept.text:
You there! $N, right?

I hope you're sure about becoming a $c, because if you can't hold your own, you're likely to get pulled under.

I'm to teach you, but I need to make sure you're strong enough first.

There was a novice studying at the Abbey who ran off to join the Defias Brotherhood. Why do I care? Well, he stole some important books.

One of those happens to be a book I've wanted for myself, the Powers of the Void. Steal it for me, they have it hidden at their tent in the Vineyards.
1598-accept.title: The Stolen Tome

1598-complete.name: Drusilla La Salle
1598-complete.text:
Excellent... I was never able to gain access to this text, it was held in a protected wing of the library that would have looked suspicious for me to be loitering around.

Well, you did a good job in getting this, and I'm convinced that you can probably handle your own imp, so there's no reason for me not to show you how to summon one.
1598-complete.title: The Stolen Tome

1598-progress.name: Drusilla La Salle
1598-progress.text: It was too conspicuous for me to steal the book myself. What luck one of their own patsies did the dirty work for me.
1598-progress.title: The Stolen Tome

1599-accept.name: Alamar Grimm
1599-accept.text:
You must be the new $c everyone's been whispering about. Must be someone's taken a liking to you if they've asked me to take time away from my research to start your training.

Don't worry, I won't hold it against you.

The simplest of the summoning spells you will learn is that of the imp. Before I impart this to you, however, you must prove that you have the necessary magical and physical ability.

Bring me three feather charms from the frostmane novices from the cave to the southwest.
1599-accept.title: Beginnings

1685-complete.name: Gakin the Darkbinder
1685-complete.text:
About time you showed up. Though, perhaps I should have sent someone more capable than Remen to find you.

No matter.

You've gone too long without training, and a $c without training isn't like to keep his head on his shoulders for long.
1685-complete.title: Gakin's Summons

1688-accept.name: Gakin the Darkbinder
1688-accept.text:
I had a student named Surena Caledon. She stood where you stand now, eager to learn of $c magic, and possessing no small bit of talent. More than that she was young and pleasing to the eye. Had I seen it then, the traitorous trollop!

The thieving wench ran off with one of the Defias, Erlan Drudgemoor. While her loss is of little importance, I gifted her a bloodstone choker that I must have.

Her life means nothing to me now. You will find her at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch. Retrieve what is mine.
1688-accept.title: Surena Caledon

1688-complete.name: Gakin the Darkbinder
1688-complete.text:
Surena was talented, but not enough so to gain mastery of $c magic on her own. It's a shame to see talent wasted, but sometimes it is necessary.

I hope my investment in you will bear different results.
1688-complete.title: Surena Caledon

1688-progress.name: Gakin the Darkbinder
1688-progress.text: Even the older and wiser can be unmanned by the wiles of youth and beauty, $N. A piece of advice you would do well to remember throughout your life.
1688-progress.title: Surena Caledon

1689-accept.name: Gakin the Darkbinder
1689-accept.text:
By retrieving my choker and besting Surena, you've proven that you're at least as capable as she was.

With that said, I can tell you're direly in need of training. You can manage the flows of magic, yes, but being a $c is much more than that.

I will show you how to command a voidwalker, but before I can, you must call one forth at a summoning circle and subdue it using whatever weapons--physical and magical--you have at your disposal. Use the magic of this choker at the summoning circle below.
1689-accept.title: The Binding

1689-complete.name: Gakin the Darkbinder
1689-complete.text:
You did better than I expected, $N, but as well as I'd hoped. Now, you can learn to command your subjugated voidwalker, an ally you will find valuable in the trials that are sure to stand before you.

I have nothing more to teach you at the present, but I am far from done with you, $N.
1689-complete.title: The Binding

1689-progress.name: Gakin the Darkbinder
1689-progress.text: I cannot show you how to control a voidwalker until you have overtaken one.
1689-progress.title: The Binding

176-complete.name: Marshal Dughan
176-complete.text:
Hah!  Well done!  I was starting to think no one would take down that monster!

Here you are, $N.  And thanks - that Gnoll was giving me a headache the size of Blackrock Spire!
176-complete.title: WANTED: "Hogger"

176-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
176-progress.text: Yes, Hogger has been a real pain for me and my men.  You have something to report about the beast?
176-progress.title: WANTED: "Hogger"

179-accept.name: Sten Stoutarm
179-accept.text:
What do we have here? You look as though you might need something to keep your hands warm, hm?

I'll tell you what would help: a pair of nice, warm gloves. And, being the kind soul that I am, I'd be more than happy to provide you with a suitable pair. I've one condition, however.

I need you to go get me some wolf meat. Nice arrangement, hm? You bring me some wolf meat, and I'll make sure you don't lose any digits to frostbite. Well, what do you say?
179-accept.title: Dwarven Outfitters

179-complete.name: Sten Stoutarm
179-complete.text: Ah! Wonderful. The wolf meat should do nicely. Oh, don't worry, $N, I wouldn't forget my part of the bargain. Here, one of these should fit you.
179-complete.title: Dwarven Outfitters

179-progress.name: Sten Stoutarm
179-progress.text: Wolves giving you a bit of trouble? You'd do well to avoid the fangs and claws and other sharp bits, yes?
179-progress.title: Dwarven Outfitters

18-accept.name: Deputy Willem
18-accept.text:
Recently, a new group of thieves has been hanging around Northshire.  They call themselves the Defias Brotherhood, and have been seen across the river to the east.

I don't know what they're up to, but I'm sure it's not good!  Bring me the bandanas they wear, and I'll reward you with a weapon.
18-accept.title: Brotherhood of Thieves

18-complete.name: Deputy Willem
18-complete.text: Back with some bandanas, I see.  The Stormwind Army appreciates your help.
18-complete.title: Brotherhood of Thieves

18-progress.name: Deputy Willem
18-progress.text: Have you gathered those bandanas for me yet?
18-progress.title: Brotherhood of Thieves

1883-accept.name: Uthel'nay
1883-accept.text:
Un'thuwa, tribal $c of Sen'jin Village, detects a disturbance in the magic currents of Durotar and asks for aid.  Speak with Un'thuwa and do what you can to help him.

Do this, and in time further secrets will be revealed to you.
1883-accept.title: Speak with Un'thuwa

21-accept.name: Marshal McBride
21-accept.text:
Your previous investigations are proof that the Echo Ridge Mine needs purging.  Return to the mine and help clear it of kobolds.

Waste no time, $N.  The longer the kobolds are left unmolested in the mine, the deeper a foothold they gain in Northshire.
21-accept.title: Skirmish at Echo Ridge

21-complete.name: Marshal McBride
21-complete.text: Once again, you have earned my respect, and the gratitude of the Stormwind Army.  There may yet be kobolds in the mine, but I will marshal others against them.  We have further tasks for you.
21-complete.title: Skirmish at Echo Ridge

2158-accept.name: Falkhaan Isenstrider
2158-accept.text:
Every adventurer should rest when exhaustion sets in - and there is no finer place to get rest and relaxation than at the Lion's Pride Inn!

My best friend, Innkeeper Farley, runs the Lion's Pride. If you tell him I sent you, he may give you the special discounted rates on food and drink.

To find the Lion's Pride Inn, travel south along the road from here -- you can't miss it!
2158-accept.title: Rest and Relaxation

2158-complete.name: Innkeeper Farley
2158-complete.text:
Rest and relaxation for the tired and cold -- that's our motto! Please, take a seat by the fire and rest your weary bones.

Would you like to try a sampling of some of our fine food and drink?
2158-complete.title: Rest and Relaxation

2161-accept.name: Ukor
2161-accept.text:
Excuse me?  Can you help me?

I have a load of food here.  I walked along the road and braved scorpids and spiders and worse!  I brought the food to the Valley of Trials because I thought they needed it and I like to help out.  But they don't need any food!  Now I have to take it back to Razor Hill and I'm afraid of all the beasts along the way...

Can you take it for me?  I'm just a peon, but you're a hero.  You fear nothing!

Take it to Innkeeper Grosk at the Razor Hill inn.  Thank you!
2161-accept.title: A Peon's Burden

2161-complete.name: Innkeeper Grosk
2161-complete.text:
Ah, this is the food Ukor brought to the Valley of Trials.  Did they not need it?  Well, I guess they like to starve you heroes in training.  Builds spirit, they say!

Thank you for returning the food.  I'll stick it back on the shelves... but here, let me offer you some refreshment first!

And don't forget to rest here in the inn.  You may be a brave $c ready to take on the world, but if your energy is sapped you won't be doing yourself, or the Horde, much good.
2161-complete.title: A Peon's Burden

22-accept.name: Salma Saldean
22-accept.text: The onions are peeled.  The garlic is minced.  The rosemary is crushed.  The crust has been baked.  The dill weed is chopped.  The gravy is simmering.  Now all I need for my famous meat pie are 8 Goretusk Livers!
22-accept.title: Goretusk Liver Pie

22-complete.name: Salma Saldean
22-complete.text: These are just perfect, $N!  Thank you so much.  Farmer Saldean and I are going to feast tonight.  And here is a little something for you, for the hard work.  You didn't think I was going to let a $c like you go hungry, did you?
22-complete.title: Goretusk Liver Pie

22-progress.name: Salma Saldean
22-progress.text: All I need for my famous meat pie are 8 Goretusk Livers!
22-progress.title: Goretusk Liver Pie

224-accept.name: Mountaineer Cobbleflint
224-accept.text:
We need to protect the Loch, $N!  With so many of the King's soldiers fighting valiantly on remote battlefields, we've become overwhelmed on the home front.  Troggs are tunneling up from every crevice!  The Trogg infestation poses the largest threat to Ironforge.  These disgusting mutants must be destroyed.

We need you, brave adventurer, to venture forth and lay waste to the Trogg threat.  Slay 10 Stonesplinter Troggs and 10 Stonesplinter Scouts and report back.
224-accept.title: In Defense of the King's Lands

224-complete.name: Mountaineer Cobbleflint
224-complete.text:
Well done, $N!  You demonstrated uncanny courage on the battlefield.  Our war against the Troggs will be won with efforts such as yours.  You have served King Magni well.

If you fancy yourself well-suited for this kind of adventuring, I suggest you speak with Mountaineer Gravelgaw.  The Captain has him assigned to a rough patrol that I am sure he can use some help with.  Check with Gravelgaw just inside the tower.
224-complete.title: In Defense of the King's Lands

233-accept.name: Sten Stoutarm
233-accept.text:
Hm, I don't suppose you'd be willing to do a favor for me, lass? A stack of letters came through the pass today, but I don't have the time to send them along.

They're all addressed to Talin Keeneye. You can find him to the west down the road. He's set up camp next to the frozen lake.

What do you say?
233-accept.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

244-accept.name: Guard Parker
244-accept.text:
Hail, $c.  I am charged to patrol this stretch of road.  Although the road is safe for now, I've seen gnoll encampments to the north and east of here.

Lakeshire must know of the gathering gnoll force!  Report to Deputy Feldon in Lakeshire and tell him of the gnolls.  Do this, and I'm sure Feldon will offer you a scout's wage.

Feldon's usually inspecting the area south of the bridge to Lakeshire.
244-accept.title: Encroaching Gnolls

244-complete.name: Deputy Feldon
244-complete.text:
There are Redridge gnolls that close to Elwynn??  They may be poised to advance into our homeland.  Soon the people of Lakeshire may not be the only humans under siege!

Here is your pay, though you bring us dire news.  And it comes at a bad time, for we are ill equipped to deal with it.
244-complete.title: Encroaching Gnolls

246-accept.name: Deputy Feldon
246-accept.text:
We don't have men to spare, but something must be done about those gnolls you reported to me.

Scout southern Redridge for gnolls.  Harry them, kill those you can and report back to me with a count of their numbers and an assessment of the threat they present.  You may find those gnolls camped all along the southern road of Redridge.

Do this for the Stormwind Army, $N, and you will be rewarded.
246-accept.title: Assessing the Threat

267-accept.name: Captain Rugelfuss
267-accept.text:
$C, you may or may not be aware of the Trogg threat looming over Dwarven lands.  With the Ironforge Reserve called up to the Alliance Front, we are left with a fraction of the defense forces needed to keep these lands safe.  My regiment is assigned to watch over the Gate here and we cannot leave our post for fear of invasion.

But we need some pressure put on those damned Troggs lurking in the hills.  If you're up to the task, wage an assault on the Troggs.  Bring me back 8 Trogg Stone Teeth as proof.
267-accept.title: The Trogg Threat

267-complete.name: Captain Rugelfuss
267-complete.text: I am quite impressed, $N.  You have done the Dwarven race a great favor by defending our lands.  King Magni Bronzebeard himself would be proud!
267-complete.title: The Trogg Threat

267-progress.name: Captain Rugelfuss
267-progress.text: Do you have 8 Trogg Stone Teeth to show me?  If not, there is still work to be done, $N.
267-progress.title: The Trogg Threat

307-accept.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
307-accept.text:
The Silver Stream Mine to the east ran dry long ago.  It was converted by the Miners' League into a storage depot, but now Kobolds have moved in, putting their filthy paws on good, Dwarven tools!

We'll root out those vermin soon enough, but the League wants someone to get their gear out of the mine before we warriors tromp in there and break things.  It'll be a tough delve - you might want cohorts at your side.

The gear is stored in Miners' League Crates throughout the mine.  Good luck.
307-accept.title: Filthy Paws

307-complete.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
307-complete.text: Did you see a lot of Kobolds in there?  I can't wait for the order to clear them out of the mine.  The thought of their grimy hands clawing around our mine makes my stomach rumble!
307-complete.title: Filthy Paws

307-progress.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
307-progress.text: Do you have that Miners' Gear, $N?
307-progress.title: Filthy Paws

3086-accept.name: Gornek
3086-accept.text:
Ah, while you were gone a tablet came for you, $N.

Read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the $c trainer Mai'ah. She would have words with you when you're ready.
3086-accept.title: Glyphic Tablet

3086-complete.name: Mai'ah
3086-complete.text:
You be among da most powerful beings on da planet, $N... there no arguin' dat. And everyone know it... know it good, too!

But ya must be weary! 'cause it not orc, or elf, or dwarf dat you should be scared of... it be da tings you can'na see. Magic be powerful. Make you do tings you may not want to do. Make ya tink you more powerful then you really be. Be patient. Be smart.

When ya tink you be ready for trainin', come back to Mai'ah. She teach you what you ready to learn, no problem.
3086-complete.title: Glyphic Tablet

3086-progress.name: Mai'ah
3086-progress.text:
Ya look to please Mai'ah already, $N. Dat be good. You give Mai'ah respect, and Mai'ah maybe give you respect back. But enough o' dat, you be here to learn 'bout magic, not hear Mai'ah talk.

There be only one ting Mai'ah can no teach you 'bout magic, $N, and dat's how to stop da corruptin'.
3086-progress.title: Glyphic Tablet

3105-accept.name: Marshal McBride
3105-accept.text: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, $N. It appears to be a letter sealed with the insignia of Drusilla, one of our local trainers. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.
3105-accept.title: Tainted Letter

3105-complete.name: Drusilla La Salle
3105-complete.text:
As you grow in power, you will be tempted--you must always remember to control yourself. I will not lie--corruption can come to any practitioner of the arcane; especially one who deals with creatures from the Twisting Nether. Be patient, and be prudent... but do not let that repress your ambition.

As you grow more powerful, return to me and I will teach you more about our ways.
3105-complete.title: Tainted Letter

3105-progress.name: Drusilla La Salle
3105-progress.text: Ah, so you've arrived, and not a moment too soon, $N. Some of the guards were over here a moment ago and were giving me curious looks... pathetic mundanes.
3105-progress.title: Tainted Letter

3115-accept.name: Sten Stoutarm
3115-accept.text:
While you were helping me out, this memorandum was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the $c trainer Alamar. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.

And watch yerself, $N, your kind ain't too trusted 'round these parts.
3115-accept.title: Tainted Memorandum

314-accept.name: Rudra Amberstill
314-accept.text:
We heard the cries in the middle of the night.  Then this morning, sure enough, the herd was missing two rams.  That dastardly beast known as Vagash has been preying on our livelihood.  With most of King Magni's army off in distant lands fighting with the Alliance, there is no one to keep Vagash at bay.

Perhaps you are brave enough to seek out the beast and slay him.  Bring me one of his fangs and I will reward you.  Vagash lurks just above the ranch here, but be warned, he is deadly.
314-accept.title: Protecting the Herd

314-complete.name: Rudra Amberstill
314-complete.text: Very well done!  Veron will be so happy when he hears the good news.  To kill Vagash is no easy task.  I imagine one day you'll be fighting alongside King Magni's men on the Alliance Front.
314-complete.title: Protecting the Herd

314-progress.name: Rudra Amberstill
314-progress.text: Vagash still terrorizes the herd!  Please help us by killing the wretched beast.
314-progress.title: Protecting the Herd

3221-accept.name: High Executor Hadrec
3221-accept.text: While you were out helping our deathstalkers, Apothecary Renferrel sent you a summons.  He did not give me details, but he wanted to speak with you about the wolf hearts you had given him.
3221-accept.title: Speak with Renferrel

3221-complete.name: Apothecary Renferrel
3221-complete.text: Ah, very good.  There is a matter regarding the wolf hearts you brought to me earlier that demands our attention.
3221-complete.title: Speak with Renferrel

33-accept.name: Eagan Peltskinner
33-accept.text:
I hate those nasty timber wolves!  But I sure like eating wolf steaks...  Bring me tough wolf meat and I will exchange it for something you'll find useful.

Tough wolf meat is gathered from hunting the timber wolves and young wolves wandering the Northshire countryside.
33-accept.title: Wolves Across the Border

33-complete.name: Eagan Peltskinner
33-complete.text:
You've been busy!  I can't wait to cook up that wolf meat...

I have some things here you might want - take your pick!
33-complete.title: Wolves Across the Border

33-progress.name: Eagan Peltskinner
33-progress.text: Hey $N.  I'm getting hungry...did you get that tough wolf meat?
33-progress.title: Wolves Across the Border

35-accept.name: Marshal Dughan
35-accept.text:
If you are concerned that the rumors of murlocs are true, then do this -- travel to the eastern Elwynn bridge and speak with Guard Thomas.  He has been stationed at the bridge for the past week and will know the state of the area.

Bring me his report.
35-accept.title: Further Concerns

35-complete.name: Guard Thomas
35-complete.text: Yes, murlocs have settled in and around the streams of eastern Elwynn.  We don't know why they are here, but they are aggressive and at least semi-intelligent.
35-complete.title: Further Concerns

353-accept.name: Grimand Elmore
353-accept.text:
The Stormpikes are a respected dwarven clan, and are well known for their fine and discerning tastes.  So it's no wonder that Gringer Stormpike, a Mountaineer of Ironforge, commissioned me to craft him a weapon.

The weapon is finished, but... Mountaineer Stormpike is far away, in distant Loch Modan.  If you plan on traveling to the north, can you deliver this package to him?

My last message from Mountaineer Stormpike said he's stationed at the northern guard tower in Loch Modan.
353-accept.title: Stormpike's Delivery

353-complete.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
353-complete.text:
Aha!  So Grimand finally finished my axe!  I can't wait to try it against some troggs and kobolds!

Many thanks, $N.  It was a long distance to travel for this delivery.   Here are some coins for your efforts.
353-complete.title: Stormpike's Delivery

353-progress.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
353-progress.text: You come all the way from Stormwind?  I hear it's getting dicey down there in the $r lands, with brigands and orcs running about.  A perfect place for a $c to prove their worth!
353-progress.title: Stormpike's Delivery

36-accept.name: Verna Furlbrow
36-accept.text:
I never thought the day would come when I'd leave the farm.  But the fields are overrun with thieves and it's far too dangerous for us here now.  As soon as Farmer Furlbrow gets the wagon fixed, we'll be on our way.  
 
Maybe you could do me a favor?  Let me scribble down my recipe for Westfall stew.  Please take it to Salma Saldean over on the farm yonder.  The Saldean's farm is just beyond the fork in the road.
36-accept.title: Westfall Stew

36-complete.name: Salma Saldean
36-complete.text: That Verna was always such a sweet lass.  We'll miss her here in Westfall but between you and me, she's a city girl at heart and Stormwind will suit her just fine.  But enough gossip!  Now we can make Westfall Stew!
36-complete.title: Westfall Stew

36-progress.name: Salma Saldean
36-progress.text: I'm going to miss that Verna Furlbrow so much.  I don't suppose you happened to see her on your way here?
36-progress.title: Westfall Stew

37-accept.name: Guard Thomas
37-accept.text:
A few days ago we sent two Guards, Rolf and Malakai, to investigate along the river, and they have not yet returned.  To complete my report, I must know what happened to those men.

Travel north along the river and find the guards... or their remains.
37-accept.title: Find the Lost Guards

37-complete.name: Unknown
37-complete.text: Although much has been stripped from the corpse, strewn nearby is a medallion with the words: "Footman Malakai Stone" etched upon it.
37-complete.title: Find the Lost Guards

38-accept.name: Salma Saldean
38-accept.text:
Help me make some Westfall Stew!  Come back with the following ingredients: 
 
 3 Stringy Vulture Meat 
 3 Goretusk Snouts 
 3 Murloc Eyes 
 3 Okra
38-accept.title: Westfall Stew

3903-accept.name: Deputy Willem
3903-accept.text:
You've shown yourself a dependable $c, $N.  Dependable, and not afraid to get your hands dirty, eh?

I have a friend, Milly Osworth, who's in some trouble.  She's over with her wagon on the other side of the abbey, near the stable.  I'm sure she could use a pair of hands like yours.
3903-accept.title: Milly Osworth

3903-complete.name: Milly Osworth
3903-complete.text:
Oh, Deputy Willem told you to speak with me?  He's a brave man and always willing to help, but his duties keep him stuck at Northshire Abbey and I'm afraid the problem I have today is beyond him.

Perhaps you can help me?
3903-complete.title: Milly Osworth

3904-accept.name: Milly Osworth
3904-accept.text:
A gang of brigands, the Defias, moved into the Northshire Vineyards while I was harvesting!  I reported it to the Northshire guards and they assured me they'd take care of things, but... I'm afraid for my crop of grapes!  If the Defias don't steal them then I fear our guards will trample them when they chase away the thugs.

Please, you must help me!  I gathered most of my grapes into buckets, but I left them in the vineyards to the southeast.

Bring me those crates!  Save my harvest!
3904-accept.title: Milly's Harvest

399-accept.name: Baros Alexston
399-accept.text:
It seems an eternity since I was a boy working the farm in Westfall. They say you can never go back, and it's true. Doubly true in my case, my family's home has been burned down and taken over by thieves.

I have spoken with my father about the fate of some of my possessions, including my first compass. He was unable to save them. However, he also says that they should be hidden away on the farm.

You'll find the Alexston Farmstead west of Sentinel Hill. Perhaps you could go and retrieve it for me?
399-accept.title: Humble Beginnings

40-accept.name: Remy "Two Times"
40-accept.text:
$N, there's a new threat in Elwynn Forest!  Murlocs are swimming up the streams of eastern Elwynn, scaring away fish and attacking gentle folk!

I warned Marshal Dughan, but he's more worried about the gnolls and the bandits.  He's not convinced that the murlocs are a danger.

Please, $N, speak to Dughan and persuade him to send more troops to the east!
40-accept.title: A Fishy Peril

40-complete.name: Marshal Dughan
40-complete.text:
Yes, I spoke with Remy.  I respect him as a merchant, though all reports of Murlocs to the east have been sketchy at best.

Your concerns are noted, but unless I receive a military report of a murloc threat, we can't afford to send more troops east.
40-complete.title: A Fishy Peril

416-accept.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
416-accept.text:
We have a real infestation problem to the west.  Tunnel rat kobolds have moved into the foothills, setting up dens and fouling our land with their filth!

We want them eliminated.  Hunt them, bring me their ears and earn their bounty.

You can find tunnel rat kobolds and their dens west of Thelsamar, littered along the mountainside.
416-accept.title: Rat Catching

416-complete.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
416-complete.text:
Ugh!  When I asked for those ears I didn't realize they'd smell so bad!

Here's your reward, $N.  Well done.
416-complete.title: Rat Catching

416-progress.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
416-progress.text: Hail, $N.  How goes the rat catching?
416-progress.title: Rat Catching

417-accept.name: Unknown
417-accept.text:
Hildelve wrote in his journal that he was attacked by Mangeclaw, a "huge Ice Claw Bear."  He drove off the beast, but not before it mauled him savagely.

Judging from the state of Hildelve's body, Mangeclaw must have later returned and killed him.

However, Hildelve wrote in his journal his one, final wish:

Revenge against Mangeclaw.
417-accept.title: A Pilot's Revenge

417-complete.name: Pilot Hammerfoot
417-complete.text:
This is grim news, for Hildelve was a good friend.  And I wish I could have been there with you when you found the beast, Mangeclaw!

Thank you, $N.  Your deed will be remembered by the pilots of the Ironforge Siege Brigade.
417-complete.title: A Pilot's Revenge

417-progress.name: Pilot Hammerfoot
417-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Do you have word of my friend Hildelve?
417-progress.title: A Pilot's Revenge

418-accept.name: Vidra Hearthstove
418-accept.text:
There's never a shortage of empty bellies here in Thelsamar, kids running in and out, workers from the excavation coming in after  a hard day's work. We're famous for our blood sausages, I don't suppose you've ever tried them?

No? Well, around here you've got to work for your meals, and don't think just because you're a fancy $c, you'll be any exception.

I'll need bear meat, boar intestines for the casings, and spider ichor for spice. You get me some of those, and leave the cooking to Vidra!
418-accept.title: Thelsamar Blood Sausages

418-complete.name: Vidra Hearthstove
418-complete.text:
Trust me, it seems a lot harder than it looks, but...

Oh, I've never known someone to take much interest in the making of sausages, but I'll give you the recipe just in case. Here you go, mind you eat them fresh!
418-complete.title: Thelsamar Blood Sausages

418-progress.name: Vidra Hearthstove
418-progress.text: I'm all ready to start cooking, do you have the ingredients for me?
418-progress.title: Thelsamar Blood Sausages

419-accept.name: Pilot Hammerfoot
419-accept.text:
My friend and fellow Siege Engine pilot, Mori Hildelve, is lost in the hills.  We were looking for a rare ore that's needed for a high-grade blastpowder, and during our search he drove his engine up a steep hill and busted it!

Still convinced that ore was in these mountains, Hildelve charged me to guard our engines while he continued on foot, searching.

It's been days, and I've heard some beastly growls in the hills at night.  Mori's tough as nails, but I'm worried.

Please, $N.  Find him.
419-accept.title: The Lost Pilot

419-complete.name: Unknown
419-complete.text:
Here is the corpse of a dwarf -- mauled, frozen, and picked clean by mountain scavengers.  Clutched in its hand is a book containing the roughly scribbled notes of Mori Hildelve.  And around its frame, still in superior condition, is a Brigadier's Vest.

This grisly scene must have been where the Siege Engine pilot met his end.
419-complete.title: The Lost Pilot

421-accept.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
421-accept.text:
Lady Sylvanas has charged Varimathras with the conquering of the human and dwarven lands to the south.

But that fool, Arugal -- charlatan of Dalaran and now cursed beast of Shadowfang Keep -- let his reckless magic wreak havoc with the strategic stronghold of Silverpine Forest.

I need someone skilled in the ways of combat to help clean up Arugal's mess.  Prove yourself to me by killing 5 Moonrage Whitescalps.  The wretched beasts can often be found just off the road, down the hill below.
421-accept.title: Prove Your Worth

421-complete.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
421-complete.text: You have served me well, $c.  It is obvious to me that you will be a worthy aide to me as I prepare to rid Silverpine Forest of Arugal's curse.
421-complete.title: Prove Your Worth

422-accept.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
422-accept.text:
How Arugal gained acceptance within the Kirin Tor is beyond me.  His spell-casting knowledge seemed as transparent as a blown glass bauble.

What's important now is learning exactly what magic Arugal used so that I can turn it against him and secure Silverpine Forest for the Dark Lady.

Arugal first stayed at the wheat farm just north of the bridge.  One of the Deathstalkers reported seeing some spellbooks but could not secure them.  Retrieve for me the spell labeled Remedy of Arugal from those books.
422-accept.title: Arugal's Folly

429-accept.name: Rane Yorick
429-accept.text:
My brother Quinn was badly hurt by the ghoul, Ivar the Foul, and I don't know if he will heal properly without alchemical aid.  Although I am not an apothecary, I do know that our apothecaries can make healing potions from the discolored hearts of worgs.

Gather such hearts and take them to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher to the south.  Then return here with the potion.

You can find plenty of worgs between here and Malden's Orchard to the east.
429-accept.title: Wild Hearts

429-complete.name: Apothecary Renferrel
429-complete.text:
<Renferrel takes the hearts.>

It is troubling to hear our Deathstalkers have failed their mission.

Let us hope that these failures are rare.

I'll give you the potion in a moment.
429-complete.title: Wild Hearts

429-progress.name: Apothecary Renferrel
429-progress.text: My time is short, $c, for the Dark Lady has charged me with a grave task.
429-progress.title: Wild Hearts

430-accept.name: Apothecary Renferrel
430-accept.text:
Here is the potion to aid in Quinn Yorick's recovery.

Now if you will excuse me, I have very important work to continue...
430-accept.title: Return to Quinn

432-accept.name: Foreman Stonebrow
432-accept.text:
Those Light-blasted troggs, turning my work site into a wreck! Look at that, there goes another barrel of powder!

Ohhh, I wish I could go down there and wring every one of their scrawny little necks! I want to kill them all!

This can't be good for my health, all this stress and anger... What have they left me with? Nothing!

I'd kill them myself, but my aim's no good anymore! You go into the quarry and kill some of the filthy buggers! I'll pay you! Just hurt them, kill them!
432-accept.title: Those Blasted Troggs!

432-complete.name: Foreman Stonebrow
432-complete.text:
Well, that makes me feel a little better...

But I won't be happy until they're all dead! All of them!
432-complete.title: Those Blasted Troggs!

433-accept.name: Senator Mehr Stonehallow
433-accept.text:
As a member of the Senate and the Explorers' League, I've taken it upon myself to take care of this part of the trogg infestation that has gripped our lands.

They've certainly made a mess of Gol'Bolar quarry, and for no reason. As we dug deep into the earth, they poured out, destroying our equipment and driving the miners out. There's not much for us to do but to exterminate the lot of them, rebuild, then get back to work.

If you help me with the troggs, I'll gladly recompense you for your time.
433-accept.title: The Public Servant

433-complete.name: Senator Mehr Stonehallow
433-complete.text:
It is a start. Hopefully we can take advantage of it, and move some Mountaineers in to secure the area. Then we can begin to restore our infrastructure and get the miners back to work.

Thank you for your assistance, $N.
433-complete.title: The Public Servant

435-accept.name: Deathstalker Erland
435-accept.text:
The wolves outside won't leave, and they eye me evilly every time I step foot out that door.  They must be incredibly hungry to think I'm worth eating.

I have to report to my teammate, the Deathstalker Rane Yorick.  And to get to Rane, I'll need help against those wolves.

Please escort me!  And there are a lot of wolves out there, so we'll have a better chance if you have friends who can help...
435-accept.title: Escorting Erland

435-complete.name: Rane Yorick
435-complete.text: Thank you for the aid, $N.  I had feared Erland was overcome by the dangers of Silverpine.  With your help, I see that he has not.
435-complete.title: Escorting Erland

437-accept.name: High Executor Hadrec
437-accept.text:
Our initial scouting reports of Silverpine show the rot hides have a base at an old farm to the north, the Dead Fields.  We have sent small assaults against them, but each time they are reinforced by the banshee Nightlash, who uses her magic to rout our forces.

We want Nightlash destroyed.

Go to the Dead Fields and assault the rot hides.  If you don't see Nightlash then kill the rot hides until she appears, then defeat her.

Her essence will turn to dust.  Bring me that dust as proof.
437-accept.title: The Dead Fields

4402-accept.name: Galgar
4402-accept.text:
It sure gets hot out here in the Valley of Trials.

<Galgar wipes his brow.>

If only I had some cactus apples, I could make my famous cactus apple surprise! Nothing cools you off faster than a piece of that delicious treat.

I'll tell you what, $N. If you bring me 10 cactus apples, I'll make you a few portions of cactus apple surprise to take with you on your adventures, and a free training manual, too. If you're interested, you can find cactus apples growing near the cactus plants around here.
4402-accept.title: Galgar's Cactus Apple Surprise

4402-complete.name: Galgar
4402-complete.text: Wonderful, $N! As promised, here is your cactus apple surprise. Pick one of these training manuals, too. I've got plenty to go around.
4402-complete.title: Galgar's Cactus Apple Surprise

4402-progress.name: Galgar
4402-progress.text: Have you finished collecting cactus apples?
4402-progress.title: Galgar's Cactus Apple Surprise

445-accept.name: Apothecary Johaan
445-accept.text:
Time is a luxury that is not afforded to those of us under the employ of Lady Sylvanas.  Surely you know this by now.

As a member of the Royal Apothecary Society it is my duty to share my knowledge with my colleagues so that our collective efforts might one day provide The Dark Lady with the New Plague she so badly desires.

Take these findings to Apothecary Renferrel who is stationed at The Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.  Follow the roads to the south from Brill.  From the Undercity go southwest.
445-accept.title: Delivery to Silverpine Forest

445-complete.name: Apothecary Renferrel
445-complete.text:
Ah, how good of Apothecary Johaan to send his research.  With so many new developments here in Silverpine, I nearly forgot about the findings coming out of Lordaeron and Tirisfal Glades.  Which reminds me, I need to get those samples off to the Necropolis soon.

But you must excuse my rambling.  Extend your stay in Silverpine, $N.  We could use an able bodied $c like you around here.
445-complete.title: Delivery to Silverpine Forest

445-progress.name: Apothecary Renferrel
445-progress.text: What business do you have with me, $c?
445-progress.title: Delivery to Silverpine Forest

447-accept.name: Apothecary Renferrel
447-accept.text:
Arthas's numbers are overwhelming. But with a New Plague we could eradicate both the Scourge Army and the Human infestation once and for all.

My studies have proven that spider blood combined with a toxin derived from a grizzled bear heart results in a deadly elixir. Collect samples from the spiders in the Skittering Dark to the northwest and from the bears wandering throughout Silverpine Forest. Deliver the reagents to Master Apothecary Faranell of the Royal Apothecary Society in the Undercity.
447-accept.title: A Recipe For Death

449-accept.name: Rane Yorick
449-accept.text: Although Quinn's wounds are mending, I want to get our report to High Executor Hadrec as quickly as possible.  It has information that is vital to the Forsaken's occupation of Silverpine.
449-accept.title: The Deathstalkers' Report

449-complete.name: High Executor Hadrec
449-complete.text:
I hadn't accounted for the level of Scourge presence we've seen in Silverpine Forest, nor for the troubles our Deathstalkers have had in their scouting efforts.

Your aid to our Deathstalkers was invaluable, $N.  And you will be commended.
449-complete.title: The Deathstalkers' Report

449-progress.name: High Executor Hadrec
449-progress.text: Did you discover the fate of the Deathstalkers?
449-progress.title: The Deathstalkers' Report

45-accept.name: Unknown
45-accept.text:
Upon further searching the area, you find webbed footprints leading east along the shore of Stone Cairn Lake.  In the distance to the east, you can just barely see a Murloc village.

Perhaps Rolf's fate ended there...
45-accept.title: Discover Rolf's Fate

45-complete.name: Unknown
45-complete.text: You find around the neck of the corpse a metal medallion inscribed with the words "Footman Rolf Hartford."
45-complete.title: Discover Rolf's Fate

47-accept.name: Remy "Two Times"
47-accept.text:
The Kobolds in these parts sometimes carry Gold Dust on them.  I could really use the stuff - bring me a load of it and I'll give you the best price in town...best price in town!

You can find kobolds in the Fargodeep Mine to the south, and around the Jasperlode Mine to the northeast.
47-accept.title: Gold Dust Exchange

47-complete.name: Remy "Two Times"
47-complete.text: Thanks for the dust, $N.  Here's your cash, and...here is a token from associates of mine.  You might find it useful...useful.
47-complete.title: Gold Dust Exchange

47-progress.name: Remy "Two Times"
47-progress.text: Psst!  You have that Gold Dust for me...for me?
47-progress.title: Gold Dust Exchange

477-accept.name: Shadow Priest Allister
477-accept.text:
As you may know, the town of Ambermill remains a source of human opposition, mainly through the support they receive from the wizards of Dalaran.

I don't know what their plan is, but for them to show interest in a backwater village like Ambermill indicates that it must have some greater importance.

They've been shipping crates by the wagon from Hillsbrad. Many of those supplies end up at a small camp north of Pyrewood Village. Retrieve the contents of a crate and return them to me.
477-accept.title: Border Crossings

509-accept.name: Apothecary Lydon
509-accept.text:
Another day, another elixir to be made. If it were up to me, I'd just let the pathetic humans and Scourge fight it out.  They seem bent on killing each other as is.

Alas, our Dark Lady wants to help speed up the process a tad so why not pass these morbid days by spreading a little death and disease across the land?

Here's the plan, $N: you go out to Nethander Stead, south of Tarren Mill and east of the river and Southshore. Collect for me 6 Mudsnout Blossoms from the field for my next elixir.
509-accept.title: Elixir of Agony

52-accept.name: Guard Thomas
52-accept.text:
Hail, $N.  Wild animals are growing more and more aggressive the farther we get from Goldshire, and the Eastvale Logging Camp suffers nearly constant attacks from wolves and bears!

We could use your help out here.
52-accept.title: Protect the Frontier

5261-accept.name: Deputy Willem
5261-accept.text:
Eagan Peltskinner is looking for someone to hunt wolves for him.  That's good news, because we're seeing a lot more wolves in Northshire Valley lately.

If you're interested then speak with Eagan.  He's around the side of the abbey, to the left.
5261-accept.title: Eagan Peltskinner

5261-complete.name: Eagan Peltskinner
5261-complete.text: That's true.  I'm looking for someone to hunt me some wolves!  Are you that person?
5261-complete.title: Eagan Peltskinner

529-progress.name: High Executor Darthalia
529-progress.text: Were you able to carry out your orders, $c?  Did you dispose of Verringtan and his assistants?  And where is that iron shipment?
529-progress.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

54-accept.name: Marshal McBride
54-accept.text:
$N, you are a $c with proven interest in the security of Northshire.  You are now tasked with the protection of the surrounding Elwynn Forest.

If you accept this duty, then I have prepared papers that must be delivered to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.  Goldshire lies along the southern road, past the border gates.
54-accept.title: Report to Goldshire

54-complete.name: Marshal Dughan
54-complete.text:
Well, it says here that you've been awarded Acting Deputy Status with the Stormwind Marshals.  Congratulations.

And good luck - keeping Elwynn safe is no picnic... what with most the army busy doing who knows what for who knows which noble!

It's hard to keep track of politics in these dark days...
54-complete.title: Report to Goldshire

54-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
54-progress.text:
You have word from McBride?  Northshire is a garden compared to Elwynn Forest, but I wonder what Marshal McBride has to report.

Here, let me have his papers...
54-progress.title: Report to Goldshire

544-accept.name: Magus Wordeen Voidglare
544-accept.text:
I came to Tarren Mill to research, but now must resolve a crisis. You see, four Forsaken fled the Undercity a few months ago. They turned their backs on their brethren, but what's worse...they stole from the Dark Lady.

These thieves broke into a secure vault and stole four artifacts, items our apothecaries required in certain studies. Sylvanas would have these artifacts returned.

The thieves fled the Undercity to Dalaran, and those wizards quarantined them in the Lordamere Internment Camp.
544-accept.title: Prison Break In

544-complete.name: Magus Wordeen Voidglare
544-complete.text:
You have done a great service for the Forsaken, $N. These artifacts have been sorely missed.

And it is good to hear that Kegan and the other betrayers have found justice.
544-complete.title: Prison Break In

544-progress.name: Magus Wordeen Voidglare
544-progress.text: Did you find the thieves? And more importantly, did you find what they stole?
544-progress.title: Prison Break In

5441-accept.name: Foreman Thazz'ril
5441-accept.text:
Cursed peons!  They work hard gathering lumber from the trees of the valley, but they're always taking naps!  I need someone to help keep the peons in line.

You look like the right $r for my task.  Here, you take this blackjack and use it on any lazy peons you find sleeping on the job.  A good smack will get them right back to work!  Return the blackjack when you're done.

Lousy slacking peons...
5441-accept.title: Lazy Peons

5441-complete.name: Foreman Thazz'ril
5441-complete.text: Good, good.  Maybe they'll think twice before slacking next time!  Thanks for the help!
5441-complete.title: Lazy Peons

5441-progress.name: Foreman Thazz'ril
5441-progress.text:
No good lazy...

 Eh?  Do you have my blackjack?  Did you catch any peons sleeping on the job?!
5441-progress.title: Lazy Peons

545-accept.name: Magus Wordeen Voidglare
545-accept.text:
Before it mysteriously vanished, there was an enormous magical barrier around the newly-reconstructed city of Dalaran. I care not what caused such a magical marvel to fail, but I do care that the newly exposed outskirts of their city may hide valuable magical treasures. Vestiges of the ruins on which the new city is built. 

But the area is patrolled by the wizards and their elemental slaves.

So hunt them, and return when their numbers are sufficiently reduced.
545-accept.title: Dalaran Patrols

545-complete.name: Magus Wordeen Voidglare
545-complete.text:
Very good. Thank you, $N.

Now we are free to pay Dalaran a little visit.
545-complete.title: Dalaran Patrols

545-progress.name: Magus Wordeen Voidglare
545-progress.text: Have you yet thinned the Dalaran patrols around their city?
545-progress.title: Dalaran Patrols

547-accept.name: Deathguard Humbert
547-accept.text:
High Executor Darthalia sent me to keep watch of Dun Garok from a distance.  I had set up camp just out of sight.  But when morning came and I had to boil water, I left to gather firewood.

When I returned to camp, I discovered my gear was missing.

Apparently some dwarven scouts from Dun Garok had passed by and made off with it.  I need my sword!  If you can get it back for me I would be so grateful.  So many dwarves there...it will be quite difficult to find the dirty little thief who stole it.
547-accept.title: Humbert's Sword

552-accept.name: Novice Thaivand
552-accept.text:
Master Helcular was almost complete with his transformation into a Lich when a human lynch mob discovered his ritual lair in the hills and brutally killed him.  To make matters worse they buried his corpse in the Southshore cemetery.

Such disregard for the great wizard is unacceptable.  As his apprentice I shall see to it that the rains of vengeance fall upon the town of Southshore.

We will need Helcular's Rod first.  Yeti overtook his ritual lair.  Undoubtedly one of the beasts has it.
552-accept.title: Helcular's Revenge

5545-accept.name: Supervisor Raelen
5545-accept.text:
I've got a real problem on my hands. I have a deadline looming for an order of lumber, and I'm running out of time. The wolves and bears north of here have chased my workers away from the bundles of wood that they've already chopped.

I've already talked to Deputy Rainer about clearing the animals, but I need someone to go collect the wood for me. If you could collect eight bundles of wood for me I might just make my deadline.
5545-accept.title: A Bundle of Trouble

5545-complete.name: Supervisor Raelen
5545-complete.text:
Excellent! Thanks to you, I should be able to complete the order in time. To show my gratitude, I would like to offer some coin as compensation for your troubles.

Thank you and farewell.
5545-complete.title: A Bundle of Trouble

5545-progress.name: Supervisor Raelen
5545-progress.text: That deadline isn't getting any further away, $c. Please hurry and collect those bundles of wood.
5545-progress.title: A Bundle of Trouble

556-accept.name: Keeper Bel'varil
556-accept.text:
A notable talent of the wizards of Dalaran is their familiarity with elementals: powerful creatures from other dimensions.  The wizards use magical tokens as a means to control these elementals.  Magus Voidglare would like some of these tokens to study.

Enter the territories of the Dalaran wizards, west of Hillsbrad, and gather the tokens.

You might find the tokens on any citizen of Dalaran, but I suggest hunting at the internment camp.  It's safer than Dalaran itself.
556-accept.title: Stone Tokens

556-complete.name: Keeper Bel'varil
556-complete.text:
These will do nicely.  Although it looks like their magic is faded, it would be best if the Magus' initial experiments were on inert specimens such as these.

Thank you, $N.
556-complete.title: Stone Tokens

556-progress.name: Keeper Bel'varil
556-progress.text: Do you have the Worn Stone Tokens, $N?  The Magus is eager to unlock their secrets.
556-progress.title: Stone Tokens

557-accept.name: Keeper Bel'varil
557-accept.text:
The Magus will be busy studying those stone tokens you gathered, but I know he'll eventually want examples of their counterpart: bracers of binding.  These are set around the wrists of actual elementals, and bind them into the mage's service.

Hunt elementals in the ruins of Dalaran and gather their Bracers of Earth Binding, and the Magus will be pleased.
557-accept.title: Bracers of Binding

5726-accept.name: Thrall
5726-accept.text:
One thing I will not tolerate are traitors in our midst, $N. But I would be a fool to play my hand so early--it would not sufficiently cut the corruption out of our lands and only cause the infection to grow worse.

But you, a young adventurer, could go places my agents could not... could learn the truth... could find the true head of the beast.

If you are brave enough, then enter Skull Rock to the east of Orgrimmar, find a lieutenant's insignia off one of the Burning Blade there, and return to me.
5726-accept.title: Hidden Enemies

5761-accept.name: Neeru Fireblade
5761-accept.text:
The primary task set upon me by our great Warchief is to root out the creatures responsible for infesting our lord's great city with demonic influence. The Burning Blade is one threat, but there are others; the Searing Blade for instance, who make their home in Ragefire Chasm, secretly attempting to subvert innocent members of the Horde.

If they are to be stopped, then their leader must be slain--a Felguard named Taragaman the Hungerer.

Kill him, and his heart will appease Thrall, of this I'm sure.
5761-accept.title: Slaying the Beast

59-complete.name: Sara Timberlain
59-complete.text:
Ah, thank you for the marker.  Please feel free to pick your choice of armor.

Luck to you, brave $c.  And may this armor serve you well.
59-complete.title: Cloth and Leather Armor

59-progress.name: Sara Timberlain
59-progress.text:
I have been commissioned by the Stormwind Army to supply their people with cloth and leather armor.

If you have a marker for me, then I'd be happy to make you something.
59-progress.title: Cloth and Leather Armor

6-accept.name: Deputy Willem
6-accept.text:
Garrick Padfoot - a cutthroat who's plagued our farmers and merchants for weeks - was seen at a shack near the vineyards, which lies east of the Abbey and across the bridge.  Bring me the villain's head, and earn his bounty!

But be wary, $N.  Garrick has gathered a gang of thugs around him.  He will not be an easy man to reach.
6-accept.title: Bounty on Garrick Padfoot

6-complete.name: Deputy Willem
6-complete.text: Hah - you caught him!  You've done Elwynn a great service, and earned a nice bounty!
6-complete.title: Bounty on Garrick Padfoot

6-progress.name: Deputy Willem
6-progress.text: Did you find Garrick's shack?  Are we finally free of that villain?
6-progress.title: Bounty on Garrick Padfoot

60-accept.name: William Pestle
60-accept.text:
Hello, my lady!  Do you have a moment?

My brother and I run an apothecary in Stormwind, and I'm here to gather large candles for their wax.  Can you help me?

You can get large candles from kobolds, and I hear rumors that kobolds are infesting the Elwynn mines ... the Fargodeep mine to the south and Jasperlode Mine to the east.  I suggest looking for candles in one of those places.
60-accept.title: Kobold Candles

60-complete.name: William Pestle
60-complete.text: You were busy hunting kobolds, were you?  Thanks for the candles, $N, and here's your reward...
60-complete.title: Kobold Candles

60-progress.name: William Pestle
60-progress.text: Did you gather those candles yet?
60-progress.title: Kobold Candles

61-accept.name: William Pestle
61-accept.text:
My brother Morgan is waiting in Stormwind for my shipment of candles.  I don't have enough time to make the trip myself, but if you'd like to take him the shipment, he'll pay you well.

I've packed up the candles, and you can find Morgan in our shop, Pestle's Apothecary, in the Stormwind Trade District.
61-accept.title: Shipment to Stormwind

61-complete.name: Morgan Pestle
61-complete.text: Here is your payment ... and while you're here, take a look around!  I'm sure we have a potion or other trinket you'd find useful.
61-complete.title: Shipment to Stormwind

61-progress.name: Morgan Pestle
61-progress.text: Oh, a shipment from my brother?  Splendid!  Fortune truly shines on me today!
61-progress.title: Shipment to Stormwind

6181-accept.name: Quartermaster Lewis
6181-accept.text:
Although we don't get much aid from Stormwind directly, I do have a contact in the city who helps supply us with armor.  His name is Osric Strang.  His shop, Limited Immunity, is in the Old Town of Stormwind.

Our supply of armor dwindles, and I must contact Osric for more.  Can you take him this note?

The fastest way to Stormwind is through Thor, our gryphon master.  He's just down the hill; bring him my note, and then take a gryphon to Stormwind.
6181-accept.title: A Swift Message

6181-complete.name: Thor
6181-complete.text: You have to get this note to Stormwind?  That's not a problem, you can take one of my gryphons!
6181-complete.title: A Swift Message

6181-progress.name: Thor
6181-progress.text: You look like you're in a hurry.  Well, then you came to the right place!
6181-progress.title: A Swift Message

62-accept.name: Marshal Dughan
62-accept.text:
The mine in Northshire isn't the only one with problems!  I have reports that the Fargodeep Mine in Elwynn has also become a haven for Kobolds.

Explore the mine and confirm these reports, then return to me.  The mine is almost due south of Goldshire, between the Stonefield and Maclure homesteads.
62-accept.title: The Fargodeep Mine

62-complete.name: Marshal Dughan
62-complete.text: This is bad news.  What's next, dragons?!?  We'll have to increase our patrols near that mine.  Thanks for your efforts, $N.  And hold a moment... I might have another task for you.
62-complete.title: The Fargodeep Mine

6261-accept.name: Osric Strang
6261-accept.text:
$N, I gathered into this crate everything Lewis asked for.  Can you take it to him?

If you've already spoken to Thor in Westfall, then you can take a gryphon back to him.  Dungar Longdrink is our gryphon master, over in the trade district.

Speak with Dungar, then get this crate to Lewis as fast as you can.  We don't want our fighting men and women in Westfall to go without fresh equipment!
6261-accept.title: Dungar Longdrink

6261-complete.name: Dungar Longdrink
6261-complete.text: A crate for Westfall, eh?  Have you been to Westfall before?  If so, then it's no problem, my friend.  I have plenty of gryphons trained to fly that route!
6261-complete.title: Dungar Longdrink

6261-progress.name: Dungar Longdrink
6261-progress.text: Is that sweat on your brow, ma'am?  You've been running too much.  Next time, take a gryphon!
6261-progress.title: Dungar Longdrink

6281-accept.name: Thor
6281-accept.text:
For a small fee, you can take a gryphon to Stormwind, so you can deliver Lewis' note to Osric.  You won't get there faster any other way.

If that sounds acceptable, then just speak to me again when you're ready for the ride.  I'll charge you a little, but trust me; it'll be worth it!
6281-accept.title: Continue to Stormwind

6281-complete.name: Osric Strang
6281-complete.text:
Ah, a note from Quartermaster Lewis?  I'm not surprised he needs more gear.  Sentinel Hill is far away, in a land Stormwind has all but forgotten.

Well thank you, $N.  Here's some money to cover your travel costs.
6281-complete.title: Continue to Stormwind

6281-progress.name: Osric Strang
6281-progress.text: You've been traveling, eh?  Have you been anywhere interesting?
6281-progress.title: Continue to Stormwind

6285-accept.name: Dungar Longdrink
6285-accept.text:
The gryphon master in Westfall is Thor.  If you've spoken to him before, then you can take one of my gryphons to him.

That's a good lesson to know: gryphons are always trained to fly to their capital city, but they'll only take you to a remote gryphon master after you've already been there.

You've already been to Thor, so just speak with me again when you're ready to take a gryphon to Westfall.  Once there, you can deliver Osric's Crate to Quartermaster Lewis.
6285-accept.title: Return to Lewis

6285-complete.name: Quartermaster Lewis
6285-complete.text:
Great, you brought the armor!  We'll get this divvied to those who need it immediately.

Thank you, $N.  Your efforts have been a great help to us.  And now that you're no stranger to gryphons, I hope you'll come and lend your aid to Sentinel Hill often!
6285-complete.title: Return to Lewis

6285-progress.name: Quartermaster Lewis
6285-progress.text: You're back from Stormwind?  Did Osric send the armor?
6285-progress.title: Return to Lewis

6394-accept.name: Foreman Thazz'ril
6394-accept.text:
$N, you are a dependable $r.  Can I count on you for another task?

Some time ago I was surveying the cave to the north for minerals, and I left my favorite pick behind.  When I later returned to retrieve it I found the cave was filled with vicious beasts!  Will you go into the cave, the Burning Blade Coven, and get my pick?

I left it in a chamber with waterfalls.  My pick has a spell on it so you can see it in the dark, so you won't have to worry about finding it... just what's guarding it!
6394-accept.title: Thazz'ril's Pick

6394-complete.name: Foreman Thazz'ril
6394-complete.text: Great, you got it!  Thanks a lot, $N.  This is my favorite pick!  Now if my peons ever finish chopping down these trees, maybe we can find a nice cave to mine!
6394-complete.title: Thazz'ril's Pick

6394-progress.name: Foreman Thazz'ril
6394-progress.text: Have you entered the Burning Blade Coven, $N?  Did you find my pick?
6394-progress.title: Thazz'ril's Pick

64-accept.name: Farmer Furlbrow
64-accept.text: It was horrible!  Verna woke me when she heard a ruckus in the fields.  The fields were full of hooligans.  We left in a rush and I forgot to pack my pocket watch.  Verna's pa gave me that watch on our wedding day and I feel just sick knowing those thieves have it.  I left the pocket watch in the wardrobe at the farmhouse.  Look for the field of pumpkins to the West -- you can't miss it.  If you bring it back to me, I'd sure be grateful!
64-accept.title: The Forgotten Heirloom

64-complete.name: Farmer Furlbrow
64-complete.text:
My watch!  Thank you so much, kind lady! 

We are but poor farmers and we have lost our land but please accept this reward as a token of our appreciation.
64-complete.title: The Forgotten Heirloom

64-progress.name: Farmer Furlbrow
64-progress.text: Don't suppose you were able to get my watch?
64-progress.title: The Forgotten Heirloom

6661-accept.name: Monty
6661-accept.text:
Avast ye scallywag. Arrrr... Arrrr ye looking fer work? We gots a serious rat problem down here an' not enough hands on the poop deck.

What do ye say? All ye needs to do is take this here rat catchin' flute and play the melody around the vermin. They'll follow ye to the ends of the world!

Just capture five of the little buggers and bring em back here. We needs em alive.

Arrrrr...
6661-accept.title: Deeprun Rat Roundup

6661-complete.name: Monty
6661-complete.text: These'll werk nicely, matey. Me brother needs em still tickin' and kickin,' else they go sour... Ye don't want to taste no sour rat kabob.
6661-complete.title: Deeprun Rat Roundup

6661-progress.name: Monty
6661-progress.text: Yarrr... Swabby, what be takin' ye so long?
6661-progress.title: Deeprun Rat Roundup

676-accept.name: Tallow
676-accept.text:
Weaklings... all of them. You, $c, what are you looking at? Think you're something special, huh? Why not prove it?

The Hammerfall outpost in Arathi's under attack. Unless we send them help soon, their demise is imminent.

But before you go rushing off, you may want to test your skills first. Northeast of Stromgarde in Arathi is an ogre mound inhabited by the Boulderfist tribe. When you can handle the ogres and enforcers there, then report to Drum Fel in Hammerfall.
676-accept.title: The Hammer May Fall

7-accept.name: Marshal McBride
7-accept.text: Your first task is one of cleansing, $N.  A clan of kobolds have infested the woods to the north.  Go there and fight the kobold vermin you find.  Reduce their numbers so that we may one day drive them from Northshire.
7-accept.title: Kobold Camp Cleanup

7-complete.name: Marshal McBride
7-complete.text:
Well done, citizen.  Those kobolds are thieves and cowards, but in large numbers they pose a threat to us.  And the humans of Stormwind do not need another threat.

For defeating them, you have my gratitude.
7-complete.title: Kobold Camp Cleanup

71-accept.name: Unknown
